name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: For sighted users to preview content available behind a link.
usageSnippet: <@trigger|props|> @marko-ui The component registry for Marko 6.

props.name: class
props.description: Extra class for the content panel.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: The duration from when the mouse leaves the trigger or content until the hover card closes.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description:
The initial open state of the hover card when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the hover card.

props.name: defaultTriggerValue
props.description:
The initial trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the trigger value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the hover card is disabled

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the popover. Useful for composition.

props.name: open
props.description: The controlled open state of the hover card

props.name: openDelay
props.description: The duration from when the mouse enters the trigger until the hover card opens.

props.name: positioning
props.description: The user provided options used to position the popover content

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Function called when the focus is moved outside the component

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Function called when an interaction happens outside the component

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Function called when the hover card opens or closes.

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Function called when the pointer is pressed down outside the component

events.name: onTriggerValueChange
events.description: Function called when the trigger value changes.

events.name: openChange
events.description: Fires when the open state changes; receives the plain open value.

accessibilityNotes: The trigger only gains hover-card behavior in addition to its native semantics — an `<a>` trigger stays a real, focusable link with its own `href`, so keyboard users can activate it directly even though the card itself opens on hover/focus.
The card opens on trigger focus as well as hover, so keyboard-only users can reveal the preview by tabbing to the trigger — no pointer required.

Closes on `Escape` and on pointer interaction outside the card; `openDelay`/`closeDelay` (default 600ms/300ms on the underlying machine) prevent the card from flickering open during incidental mouse movement.

examples.description: Use `openDelay` and `closeDelay` (in milliseconds) to control how quickly the card opens and closes.

examples.source:

examples.description: Pass `disabled` to prevent the hover card from ever opening.

composition: `HoverCard` is a single component, not three. Where upstream composes `HoverCard` / `HoverCardTrigger` / `HoverCardContent`, this port folds trigger and content into `HoverCard` itself: the `@trigger` render-prop receives the machine's trigger attributes to spread onto whatever element opens the card, and the tag's own body supplies what's shown once the pointer lingers. There is no separate `HoverCardTrigger` or `HoverCardContent` tag to import.
